root.label: Lublin reopens Cold War-era air raid shelter

events.label: Lublin reopens Cold War-era air raid shelter

slots.name: shelter capacity
slots.sentence: "It provides shelter for 200 people for up to 72 hours, ensuring access to air, water and electricity independent of external power grids," Kamil Rzad, a civil defence inspector at MPK Lublin, told Reuters.
